description:
Parent: zaq-ic9.14. Read the parent contract and inherited policies before work. This task stays blocked until its recorded prerequisite is complete.

Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add:
Add the focused selection Action and register it in lib/zaq/agent/tools/registry.ex using established enablement controls. Input operation add/remove/replace plus Records; validated Records output and supported selection effects. Whole-batch validation before mutation; explicit permission context; no bytes acquisition, source deletion or immediate delivery. Exact module path and state-effect construction depend on discovery.

Tests to add before implementation:
Unit/property tests for valid schema, add/remove/replace/empty replacement, absent removal, duplicates, bounds, malformed/forged Records, alias round trip, nil/unauthorized actor rejection and atomic invalid-batch rejection. Registration and enablement tests.

Branches/paths validated:
Cover success, invalid input/authorization, lifecycle and propagation paths relevant to this step; preserve the parent's add/remove/replace, atomicity, request isolation and privacy invariants.

Mocking plan:
Keep internal ZAQ and Jido boundaries real where supported; mock only external model/provider/network edges. No shared global test configuration. Discovery must identify any hard constraint before test-only abstractions are added.

Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content:
Record evidence, decisions and validation in this issue. Update affected module docs and docs/services/agent.md with implementation; final documentation consistency is checked by the validation task. Do not describe proposed behavior as shipped.

Action reuse assessment:
Proposed new Action: retrieval tools such as GetDocument do not own response selection. Reuse existing Record/provenance/permission APIs verified by discovery; invoke via validated Jido execution. Agent-tool consumer is intended; standalone/workflow support must not be assumed without active execution context. No duplicated authorization.

Gates:
Follow docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md and docs/testing-approach.md. Discovery must resolve unknown contracts and finalize this step before coding. Existing test behavior changes require explicit human approval. No commit/push/merge implied.

comments.text: Paused and returned to open because discovery reopened on a proven shared-provenance authorization mismatch. Removed only this turn’s provisional Action, Registry entry and unfinished Action tests; retained passing native Jido characterization. No existing tests or unrelated code changed. Latest draft Action tests had 4/5 passing; remaining new scope-argument assertion exposed schema conversion stripping unknown keys (future test must assert trusted scope wins rather than expecting rejection). No production selection implementation is being represented as complete. Human security-contract decision requested before resolving .1 and resuming dependency order.

Implemented new AttachDocuments Action using existing Record.zoi_type provenance validation, OpaqueAliases schema paths and Record.Authorization; no download/delete/delivery. Input bounds 100 Records, add/remove/replace, scope from trusted context only, nil identity denied unless explicit bypass. New focused tests 5 passed including property; Registry suite has 2 expected failures in exact list assertions because new key is missing. Requested explicit approval to add only message.attach_documents to the two lists, preserving all existing entries/assertions. Existing tests untouched pending response; issue stays in_progress.

Latest validation: new AttachDocuments suite 5 passed (1 property,4 tests); mix q passed after fixing new-test alias style. Remaining issue acceptance blocker is explicit approval for two existing Registry exact-list expectations, currently failing solely because they exclude new message.attach_documents. Requested narrowly scoped approval through session question; no existing test changed. .3 not started because dependency order must be preserved. Retained all implementation uncommitted; no precommit/commit/push/merge/bw sync.

User explicitly approved the two existing Registry list expectation updates (yes). Added only message.attach_documents to those lists, keeping all prior keys and exact assertions. Continuing issue validation; uncommitted work is authorized by original delivery instructions.

Approved Registry expectations updated. Focused Action+Registry suite 31 passed (1 property,30 tests); mix q passed. Action schema/authorization/alias/atomic invalid-batch behavior and enablement verified. Commands remain inert until owning runtime integration in .3; no early delivery or source deletion. Acceptance criteria satisfied at the Action boundary.

Validation review found provider-owned ACL compatibility gap: DiskBridge maps type/target_id grants and owns permission checks in Storage; Record.Authorization intentionally understands external provider principal/channel ACLs only. Generic local check therefore denies legitimate Disk users. Reopened owning issue before correction. Action reuse extension: for Records with signed provider/config identity, reuse GetDocument through validated Jido.Exec.run to refresh canonical metadata and apply existing Channels/Storage authorization (no bytes download), then validate the complete batch before selection effect. Generic signed Records without provider claims retain Record.Authorization. No new authorization Action/API, duplicated ACL rules or implicit nil bypass. Add real disk-person granted/denied integration proof; preserve all existing tests.

Provider-owned ACL correction validated. For signed data-source identity, AttachDocuments runs existing GetDocument through Jido.Exec with signed provider/config/document IDs and trusted actor, returning current canonical metadata; no file bytes. Other signed Records retain generic Record.Authorization. Whole-batch validation still precedes effects. Added real Disk person/grant proof, failed mixed-batch replacement preserving B, and post-selection revocation denial at final Storage redemption. Fixtures now obtain Records through real GetDocument rather than synthesizing provider contracts. Focused Action+Registry+delivery suite 36 passed (1 property,35 tests); mix q passed. Existing tests unchanged except previously approved two Registry keys.

Jad requested renaming the configured-agent registry key after the Action moved into DataSource, including all references/tests. Interpreting attach_documnet as attach_document, stated in commentary. Rename message.attach_documents to data_source.attach_document; reuse the existing bulk AttachDocuments Action/model tool attach_documents without changing selection behavior. Existing test key expectations explicitly authorized by the request. No new Action, compatibility alias, ZAQ commit/push, or precommit repeat.

title: [zaq-ic9.14.2] Implement attach_documents Action and tool registration
